method: Real attached phone, native Chrome/Worker/IndexedDB/touch, sequential captures, no CPU/viewport emulation. Shallow captures: 12s warmup then 12s sample. Stock native policies except explicit synthetic parked-grid fixtures. One pre-existing empty-URL debug target was excluded through a task-local CDP relay; sampling timers run inside phone. Original browser tabs/origins preserved, owned tabs/routes/relay closed, original foreground restored.
limits: Callbacks do not measure physical display presents or hardware GPU duration. Fresh seed-2026 worlds, not owner saved depot. Parked grid can obstruct racers, so fleet is a rendering-density comparison, not unchanged race simulation. Trace ends at thermal status 1 and is excluded from clean performance comparisons. No runtime optimization shipped.
